question: Choose the incorrectly spelt word.
solution:
The incorrectly spelled word is option 3, "Agravate." The correct spelling is "Aggravate."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word "aggravate" means to make a problem or situation worse.
 
• Option 1, "Cramp," is spelled correctly. It refers to a sudden, painful contraction of a muscle.
 
• Option 2, "Damp," is also spelled correctly. It means slightly wet or moist.
 
• Option 4, "Stamp," is spelled correctly. It can refer to a mark made by pressing or hitting something, or to a small piece of paper with a design on it that is used to show payment or approval.
